test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Sycophant
solution: The correct answer is: **Flatterer**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Sycophant **means a person who flatters someone in order to gain an advantage. (वह व्यक्ति जो लाभ पाने के लिए किसी की चापलूसी करता है) • **For example**: *The sycophant fawned over the boss, hoping for a promotion.* • Marked option **Flatterer **means a person who praises or compliments someone excessively or insincerely. (वह व्यक्ति जो किसी की अत्यधिक या निष्ठापूर्वक प्रशंसा करता है) • **For example**: *The flatterer told the actress that she was the most beautiful woman in the world.* • Other synonyms of Sycophant are Fawner, Toady, Yes-man. Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Mammoth**: A large extinct elephant-like mammal. (एक बड़ा विलुप्त हाथी जैसा स्तनपायी) • **Killer**: A person or thing that kills or causes death. (वह व्यक्ति या वस्तु जो मारता है या मृत्यु का कारण बनता है) • **Psycho**: A mentally unstable person. (मानसिक रूप से अस्थिर व्यक्ति) 185:T6db, The correct answer is: "**Hopefully, our team will win the match.**"
